assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production transparent 12-frame Reaper animation sprite sheet for a 2D side-scrolling game. Keep body and head scale IDENTICAL across all twelve frames, feet on a consistent per-row baseline, broad transparent margins between complete silhouettes, entire scythe inside each cell, no overlap between cells. Crisp hand-painted dark fantasy style matching the reference, consistent black red gold palette, clear mobile readability. No crossbow, no merchant, no architecture, no floor, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no glow or background outside each silhouette. Genuinely transparent background.
